items.title: Floods disrupt livelihoods of 21,400 workers in Nepal: ILO
items.blurb: The UN agency says damage to homes, workplaces, roads, bridges and energy infrastructure could spread employment and income losses far beyond flood-hit areas.

items.title: Celebrating new China’s remarkable achievements, writing a new chapter in Nepal-China relations
items.blurb: As China marks the 77th anniversary of its founding, its ambassador to Nepal, Zhang Maoming, reflects on the countries’ longstanding ties, growing cooperation and joint response to cross-border disasters.

items.title: Roads reopen, travel gets easier
items.blurb: Major highways damaged by floods and landslides are reopening, easing travel and daily life ahead of Dashain.

items.title: 2015 earthquake victims waited for a safer home. Then came the flood
items.blurb: A decade later, many families still lack home and land. The government is now preparing to relocate those displaced by floods, but experts warn that livelihoods and social ties must be considered.

items.title: In disaster’s wake, Nepal government allegedly rushes climate policy for COP 31
items.blurb: Stakeholders have grouped to collect and forward recommendations to the government to be incorporated into the draft policy.

items.title: Digging through the mud for leftover memories
items.blurb: More than a month after the catastrophic floods, people in Nuwakot are combing the wreckage of their homes and shops for documents, photo frames, keepsakes, and anything else they can salvage.

items.title: Nepal flood survivors are leaving temporary camps as government delays rehabilitation
items.blurb: The number of people in makeshift shelters has fallen to around 1,000 from 4,500, as poor conditions force survivors to leave while the government delays rehabilitation and financial assistance.

items.title: Three more bodies recovered from Himlung avalanche site
items.blurb: The latest recovery takes the number of bodies found so far to seven, while nine Nepalis remain missing after the September 27 avalanche.

items.title: Israel-bound flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after brawl between pilots, Israeli official says
items.blurb: The Flydubai flight diverted to Tabuk after the pilots allegedly got into a physical altercation, triggering emergency signals and a major security response in Israel.

items.title: Flood-swollen Marsyangdi river cuts off Upper Manang
items.blurb: A submerged bridge and debris-choked river have blocked the main road to Upper Manang, leaving residents unable to reach Chame.
